ui_bugs.issue: Console error 'Error: <path> attribute d: Expected moveto path command (M or m), "undefined"' still fires 4x per homepage load. Cause: framer-motion cannot interpolate SVG path 'd' strings, so during the animate={{ d: path }} tween it writes d=undefined onto the <path>. MiniSparkline guards (Session 74.2) did NOT fix this because MiniSparkline was never the source (it only mounts for curated symbols on authed watchlist pages). Fix: drop 'd' from the animate object (animate only opacity) or pass initial={false}/use flubber-based path interpolation.

rca_of_the_issue: Console error stack: renderSVG (framer-motion) -> SVGVisualElement.renderInstance -> setAttribute('d', undefined). EditorialDonut.jsx passes animate={{ d: path || 'M0 0' }} to motion.path; framer-motion has no built-in path-data interpolation, so the value type resolves to undefined during the tween and is written to the DOM attribute, triggering the browser SVG parse error 4x (one per donut arc). Mitigation: animate only opacity/transform and set d as a plain prop, or use a path interpolator (flubber) via a MotionValue.
